description: This file defines the CommonEncryptionData class used for parsing and managing encryption key data, including handling of PSSH boxes, XML, and JSON init data for content decryption modules in a media framework.

classes.name: CommonEncryptionData
classes.description: Class for parsing and managing encryption key data, supporting PSSH, XML, and JSON formats.

classes.name: CommonEncryptionData::KeyId
classes.description: Represents a key identifier with associated system flags, extending OCDM::KeyId.

methods.name: CommonEncryptionData::CommonEncryptionData
methods.description: Constructor that parses input data to extract encryption keys.

methods.name: CommonEncryptionData::AddKeyId
methods.description: Adds or updates a key ID in the internal list.

methods.name: CommonEncryptionData::Status(const KeyId&)
methods.description: Returns the key status for a specific key ID.

methods.name: CommonEncryptionData::Keys
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the key IDs.

methods.name: CommonEncryptionData::IsSupported
methods.description: Checks if the current keys support another set of keys.

methods.name: CommonEncryptionData::IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if there are no keys stored.

methods.name: CommonEncryptionData::Parse
methods.description: Parses the input data to extract PSSH, XML, or JSON key information.

methods.name: CommonEncryptionData::ParsePSSHBox
methods.description: Parses a PSSH box to extract key IDs based on system type.

methods.name: CommonEncryptionData::ParseXMLBox
methods.description: Parses XML data to extract key IDs.

methods.name: CommonEncryptionData::ParseJSONInitData
methods.description: Parses JSON formatted init data to extract key IDs.
